name: HackSynth CTF Benchmarks
description: Two new Capture The Flag (CTF)-based benchmark sets utilizing PicoCTF and OverTheWire platforms, consisting of 200 challenges across diverse domains and difficulties, designed to evaluate LLM-based autonomous penetration testing agents.
reputation: A recent CTF-based benchmark for autonomous penetration testing agents, built on widely used training platforms in the security community.
notes: Benchmark focuses on autonomous penetration testing with LLM agents; publicly available to foster research.
